what: Diagnosed rebuild of ocha-fts-appeal-funding-trajectory (fts-appeal-002), the ONE rebuild permitted for its defect class after fts-appeal-001 succeeded end to end (gate 1.5.0 failed_checks empty, exact-byte ACCEPTED for artifact 893b2e78a4812dcc... on the worker, all three fixtures matched to the dollar, flow-vs-CSV mismatch 36/757 = 4.75% within the 10% guard; that artifact is preserved in staging release 430422823 and its references recorded). Stopping condition: any failed stage exits non-zero leaving its logs and diagnostics for collection; a fixture or cross-check failure means diagnose before ANY rebuild - this is already the one permitted rebuild for the meta-key defect class, so a failure here (of any class) is recorded, not blindly retried.
